417:2.name: Button
417:2.description: The labelled action control that every transactional moment in Safqah routes through (invest, reserve, withdraw, confirm, cancel). Six variants encode how loud and how risky the action is.
useWhen: The single main action of a screen or sheet, such as «استثمر الآن» on a deal page or «تأكيد» in an investment confirmation: Variant=primary, Size=lg
The escape or alternative action next to a primary (Cancel, Back): Variant=secondary
Irreversible actions such as withdrawing before maturity or deleting an account, always behind a confirmation: Variant=destructive
Submit blocked by validation errors or a Retry after a failed request: Variant=error
dontUseWhen: The click moves the user to another route or URL (terms, Learn more, Forgot password as navigation): use Link
The action is a universally understood icon with no label (close, share, copy): use IconButton
Two or three related actions must sit together with set spacing and order: wrap them in ButtonGroup
Signing in with Nafath, Apple or Google: use SocialButton
A persistent screen-level action floating over scroll content: use FAB / Standard or FAB / Extended
417:2.keyProps: Variant (primary, secondary, tertiary, destructive, error, text), Size (lg, md, sm), State (loading for async), Label, Has icon leading / Has icon trailing with Icon leading / Icon trailing; Direction is documentation only, runtime follows locale.
417:2.a11y: At most one primary per screen; sm (32px) is below the 44pt touch target, so keep lg or md on mobile and block taps while State=loading to avoid duplicate investment submissions.

502:729.name: IconButton
502:729.description: A square, label-less button carrying one centered icon, with the same six variants and states as Button. Used for compact, unambiguous actions such as closing a sheet, copying an IBAN or opening a more menu.
useWhen: Close X on a BottomSheet, Modal or Toast: Variant=text
Copy, share or bookmark actions on a deal card or list row: Variant=tertiary
Retry next to a failed upload or network error: Variant=error with a refresh icon
A trash icon to delete a draft or remove a document, followed by confirmation: Variant=destructive
dontUseWhen: The icon meaning is not universal (filter, sort, Sukuk, Sharia, KYC concepts): use Button with a leading icon and a label
A back arrow in the app header: use BackButton
The single main floating action of a screen: use FAB / Standard
Navigating to another page with text: use Link
502:729.keyProps: Icon (instance swap from the Syntropy icon set), Variant (primary, secondary, tertiary, destructive, error, text), Size (lg 48, md 40, sm 32), State; no Direction axis, swap directional icons per locale instead.
502:729.a11y: Every instance needs a verb-object semantic label (for example «نسخ رقم الآيبان»), and md/sm need parent padding to reach a 44pt tap target.

516:2.name: Link
516:2.description: Inline underlined text that navigates to another route, URL or document. It moves the user somewhere else and never changes state in the current context.
useWhen: Opening terms, the CMA disclosure, the Sharia board page or a glossary entry from body copy: Variant=info or default
Downloading an offering file or statement PDF: leading document icon
External destinations such as safqah.co: trailing arrow-up-right icon
Low-priority paths like «لاحقاً» or Skip this step: Variant=muted
dontUseWhen: The click submits, saves, confirms or deletes in place: use Button (Variant=text for an inline-looking action)
Async work with a loading state is needed: use Button
A row in a settings list that opens a detail screen: use ListItem with a chevron
516:2.keyProps: Variant (default, info, danger, inverse, primary, muted), Size (lg, md, sm) matched to surrounding text, Underline, Has icon leading / Has icon trailing, Href, State; not yet in the published library.
516:2.a11y: Keep Underline on (the default green fails AA contrast in light mode without it) and announce it as a link, with a hint when it opens outside the app.

640:701.name: FAB / Standard
640:701.description: A circular floating action button anchored to the bottom-trailing corner, above scroll content, holding the one most important action of a view as an icon.
useWhen: A persistent jump back to the deals feed or a new-investment entry on a long scrolling screen: Variant=primary, Size=default
A quiet persistent help or support entry point: Variant=secondary
dontUseWhen: The action needs a word to be understood (first-time users, unfamiliar action): use FAB / Extended
A screen needs more than one persistent action: use IconButton or a FAB speed-dial
The main action belongs in the page or sheet footer (Invest, Confirm): use Button
Cancelling an investment on a primary surface: keep destructive actions inside a Dialog with Button Variant=destructive
640:701.keyProps: Icon (instance swap), Variant (primary, secondary, destructive), Size (small 40, default 56, large 96), State; elevation comes from Shadow effect styles.
640:701.a11y: Never ship Size=small as the only touch action on mobile (40dp fails the target size) and give the icon-only FAB a semantic label.

738:1944.name: FAB / Extended
738:1944.description: A pill-shaped floating action button with a leading icon and a label, used when the single floating screen action needs words to be clear.
useWhen: A labelled new-investment action on the portfolio screen, for example «استثمار جديد»
First-time or unfamiliar actions where an icon alone would be ambiguous
dontUseWhen: The icon alone is universally clear: use FAB / Standard
Support or chat entry points that should not compete with the main action: use FAB / Standard with Variant=secondary
The action belongs in a form or sheet footer: use Button
738:1944.keyProps: Label, Icon (instance swap), Variant (primary, secondary, destructive), State; single fixed size (56dp high), Direction follows locale so the label leads in Arabic.
738:1944.a11y: One FAB per view at most, and keep the label short so it does not cover content near the bottom-trailing corner.

792:290.name: ButtonGroup
792:290.description: A chromeless layout container that places two or three Button instances with consistent orientation, spacing, alignment and reading-order direction.
useWhen: Dialog and BottomSheet footers with Confirm plus Cancel
Card-level CTAs on a deal card (Invest plus Details)
Onboarding Skip plus Continue: Alignment=space-between
Narrow mobile sheets where actions must stack: Orientation=vertical
dontUseWhen: There is only one action: use a single Button
Four or more actions: keep one primary Button and move the rest into a Menu
Buttons that share edges to switch a view or a value: use SegmentedControl_2 (or _3/_4/_5)
Selectable filter chips: use Tag Group
792:290.keyProps: Orientation (horizontal, vertical), Spacing (tight, default, loose), Alignment (start, center, end, space-between), Show Button 1/2/3 with Button 1/2/3 swaps, Direction.
792:290.a11y: Button 1 is the primary in reading order, so the visual flip in Arabic keeps the same screen-reader order; switch to vertical rather than truncating labels.

805:249.name: SocialButton
805:249.description: A neutral, brand-agnostic button for third-party identity and sign-in providers, where the provider logo carries the brand. On Safqah it is mainly the «تسجيل الدخول عبر نفاذ» entry for Nafath identity verification.
useWhen: Nafath sign-in or KYC identity verification
Continue with Apple or Google on sign-up and login screens
Re-authentication from settings: Size=sm with an extended tap area
dontUseWhen: A normal in-app action like Invest or Continue: use Button
Linking a bank account or IBAN: use Button inside the form flow
Showing a provider logo without an action: use AbshirLogo, MadaLogo or the relevant logo component
805:249.keyProps: Label, Icon (provider logo swap), Show Icon, Size (lg, md, sm), State (loading during auth), Direction; not yet in the published library.
805:249.a11y: Switch to State=loading immediately on tap to prevent duplicate auth requests, and do not use sm (32dp) as the only sign-in control.

828:705.name: Input
828:705.description: The standard bordered single-line text field with label above and helper or error text below. Used across sign-up, KYC questionnaires, beneficiary details and settings.
useWhen: Free text such as full name, email, national ID or IBAN in KYC and bank forms
Any labelled single-line field in a standard bordered form
Fields that need inline validation messages under the field
dontUseWhen: Phone numbers: use Input Phone
SAR amounts to invest or withdraw: use Input Amount
Picking from a closed list: use Select (or Combobox for long lists)
Multi-line text: use TextArea
Verification codes: use OTP Input
Search: use Search Input
828:705.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size (lg, md, sm), Show Label, Label text, Show Helper, Helper text, Direction; not yet in the published library.
828:705.a11y: Errors go in the helper under the field (linked to it) with a specific message; never mark required in the placeholder.

859:2214.name: Input Underline
859:2214.description: A minimal single-line text field with only a bottom line (and a leading accent on focus) instead of a full border. Used on registration, sign-in and onboarding screens.
useWhen: Sign-up and sign-in screens where the form should feel light
Onboarding steps with one or two fields
dontUseWhen: Standard dense forms such as KYC or bank details: use Input
Mixing styles in one form: pick Input or Input Underline for the whole form
Phone number entry: use Input Phone
859:2214.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Helper text, Direction; not yet in the published library.
859:2214.a11y: With no box, the focus accent and red error underline are the only state cues, so always pair error with helper text.

821:17.name: Input Label
821:17.description: The text label atom placed above input fields, with an optional red asterisk for required fields.
useWhen: Building a custom field layout that needs the standard input label
Group labels inside Radio Group
dontUseWhen: New form layouts that need a tooltip icon or direction-aware label: use Form Field Label
A full labelled field: use Input or Form Field instead of assembling atoms
821:17.keyProps: Label text, Size (lg, md, sm), Required (false, true).
821:17.a11y: Use Required=true for the visual asterisk and also mark the field required in code.

822:6.name: Input Helper Text
822:6.description: The small text atom under a field for a hint or a validation error message.
useWhen: Hints such as «الحد الأدنى للاستثمار 1,000 ر.س» under a field
Field-level validation errors: Tone=error
dontUseWhen: Success or info messages with icons: use Form Field Helper
Form-level or system errors: use Alert or Banner
Brief confirmations after an action: use Toast
822:6.a11y: Associate the helper with its field so the error is read when the field gets focus.

823:14.name: Input Value
823:14.description: The text atom inside a field that shows either the muted placeholder or the typed value.
useWhen: Inside Input Field or Input Underline Field (swapped through their Value prop)
Custom inline edit cells that need the standard value typography
dontUseWhen: Phone numbers with country code: use Input Phone Value
SAR amounts: use Input Amount Value
Select placeholders with a chevron: use Select Value
823:14.keyProps: Text, Size (lg, md, sm), State (placeholder, value).
823:14.a11y: Placeholder is not a label; the field still needs Input Label or Form Field Label.

876:2229.name: Input Phone Value
876:2229.description: The value atom for phone fields: a bold country code (default +966) with a chevron and separator, followed by the phone number area.
useWhen: Inside Input Phone for Saudi mobile numbers (5X XXX XXXX)
Hiding the country chunk when the market is fixed: Show Country=false
dontUseWhen: Any non-phone text: use Input Value
A complete labelled phone field: use Input Phone
876:2229.keyProps: Country code, Phone text, Show Country, Show Dropdown, Size, State (placeholder, value), Direction.
876:2229.a11y: The country picker opened from the chevron is app-level; give the country chunk its own accessible name if it is tappable.

826:579.name: Input Field
826:579.description: The bare bordered input box (value plus optional leading or trailing icon) without label or helper. It is the default slot inside Form Field and the control for inline edit cells.
useWhen: The input slot of Form Field
Inline edit cells or table filters where the column header acts as the label
Fields with a leading icon (lock, mail) or trailing action (clear, eye toggle): Icon=leading or trailing
dontUseWhen: A normal labelled form field: use Input or Form Field
Search boxes: use Search Input
Minimal underline style: use Input Underline Field
826:579.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Icon (none, leading, trailing), Value / Leading icon / Trailing icon swaps, Direction.
826:579.a11y: Without its own label it must get an accessible name from the surrounding label or column header.

857:2088.name: Input Underline Field
857:2088.description: The bare underline-style input box (bottom stroke, leading accent on focus) without label or helper, used inside Input Underline.
useWhen: Inside Input Underline
Custom light-weight sign-in layouts that compose their own label
dontUseWhen: Bordered forms or Form Field slots: use Input Field
A complete labelled field: use Input Underline
857:2088.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Icon (none, leading, trailing), Value swap, Direction.
857:2088.a11y: Needs an external label; focus is shown only by the 2dp accent and darker underline.

878:2355.name: Input Phone
878:2355.description: A labelled phone number field with a country code prefix (default +966) and the number area. Used for sign-up, KYC, account recovery and beneficiary contacts.
useWhen: Sign-up and login by mobile number, for example label «رقم الجوال»
Recovery contact and KYC contact details
dontUseWhen: Verifying the SMS code sent to that number: use OTP Input
Other free text: use Input
878:2355.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Helper text, Direction; country code is overridden on the nested Input Phone Value; not yet in the published library.
878:2355.a11y: Use a numeric phone keyboard and keep digits Western (0-9) and left-to-right inside the RTL field.

923:77.name: OTP Input
923:77.description: A row of 4 or 6 square digit boxes for one-time codes, with a clear focus ring on the active box. Used for SMS login OTP, Nafath, 2FA and confirming high-value investments or withdrawals.
useWhen: SMS OTP after login or phone change: Length=4
Authenticator or 6-digit codes: Length=6 (Size=md on narrow phones)
Confirming a withdrawal to IBAN or a large investment
dontUseWhen: Phone number entry: use Input Phone
Passwords or longer codes: use Input
Small quantities: use NumericStepper
923:77.keyProps: Length (4, 6), State (empty, partial, complete, error, disabled), Size (lg, md), OTP code (design-time only), Direction; not yet in the published library.
923:77.a11y: Keep digits visible on error instead of clearing them, and set State=disabled during verification to stop duplicate submissions.

946:480.name: Input Amount Value
946:480.description: The SAR amount display atom: Riyal symbol, a large bold integer and small muted decimals, so the figure reads first.
useWhen: Inside Input Amount and Amount Stepper
Custom amount fields that must match the Safqah amount typography
dontUseWhen: Read-only balances and returns outside a field: use MoneyAmount
Plain text values: use Input Value
946:480.keyProps: Amount, Decimals (default .00), Size (lg, md, sm), State (placeholder, value), Direction.
946:480.a11y: Read the amount and currency as one phrase (for example «1,000 ريال») rather than the symbol glyph alone.

952:636.name: Input Amount
952:636.description: A labelled, taller bordered field for typing a free-form SAR amount, with the amount as the hero and a helper for limits. Used for investment amount, top-up, withdrawal and income fields.
useWhen: Entering the investment amount on a deal page: Size=lg, helper «الحد الأدنى للاستثمار 1,000 ر.س»
Withdrawal or wallet top-up amounts
Showing a locked amount during confirmation: State=disabled
dontUseWhen: Amounts that change in fixed steps (for example 1,000 SAR units): use Amount Stepper
Approximate values along a range: use Slider Field
Small integer counts: use NumericStepper
Non-money text: use Input
952:636.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Helper text, Direction; not yet in the published library.
952:636.a11y: On validation failure keep the typed amount visible with a specific error in the helper, never reset to 0.

1010:1401.name: Amount Stepper
1010:1401.description: A bordered SAR amount with minus and plus buttons on either side, for amounts that move in fixed steps. With Show Actions=false it becomes a read-only amount box.
useWhen: Adjusting an investment in fixed units (each step 1,000 SAR)
Recurring contribution levels or tiered amounts
Read-only amount summaries that match stepper rhythm: Show Actions=false
dontUseWhen: Free-form amounts the user types: use Input Amount
Plain integer counts without currency: use NumericStepper
1010:1401.keyProps: Show Actions, State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size (lg, md, sm), Direction (plus and minus swap sides in RTL).
1010:1401.a11y: Give the minus and plus chunks accessible names and disable them at the min and max rather than ignoring taps.

1065:1128.name: Select Underline
1065:1128.description: A Select with only a bottom underline instead of a full border; same behavior and Dropdown Menu, lighter chrome for dense forms.
useWhen: Dense settings or admin forms with many fields
Forms already using Input Underline
dontUseWhen: Standard bordered forms: use Select
Long lists that need typing: use Combobox Field with Combobox Menu
Two to five options visible at once: use Radio Group
1065:1128.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Helper text, Direction; not yet in the published library.
1065:1128.a11y: Announce it as a collapsed or expanded popup button, same as Select.

1022:57.name: Select Value
1022:57.description: The value atom inside a Select: placeholder or chosen value plus the trailing chevron.
useWhen: Inside Select and Select Underline (exposed so the shown text can be overridden)
dontUseWhen: Typed text values: use Input Value
A complete picker field: use Select
1022:57.keyProps: Text, Show Icon, Size, State (placeholder, value), Direction.
1022:57.a11y: The chevron rotation for the open state is runtime; expose expanded state in code.

1026:183.name: Dropdown Item
1026:183.description: One option row in a dropdown list, with a check mark when selected. Shared by Select and Combobox so options look identical.
useWhen: Option rows inside Dropdown Menu or Combobox Menu
A disabled option the user cannot pick: State=disabled
dontUseWhen: Action rows in an overflow menu: use MenuItem
Search results with subtitles or icons: use Search Result Item
Selectable rows on a full screen: use SelectRow
1026:183.keyProps: Label, Size (lg, md, sm), State (default, hover, selected, disabled), Direction.
1026:183.a11y: Expose as an option with selected state; selection must not rely on the green check alone.

1028:279.name: Dropdown Menu
1028:279.description: The floating list of Dropdown Item options that opens from a Select (rendered in an overlay at runtime).
useWhen: The open state of Select or Select Underline
Simple single-choice lists anchored to a field
dontUseWhen: Overflow or action menus: use Menu
Filtering by typing: use Combobox Menu
Mobile pickers with many options or rich content: use BottomSheet
1028:279.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), Direction; override the Label on each nested Dropdown Item.
1028:279.a11y: Move focus into the list on open, support arrow keys, and return focus to the Select on close.

1024:183.name: Select
1024:183.description: A bordered picker field that opens a Dropdown Menu to choose one value from a closed list. Used for country, region, payment method, contribution frequency and language.
useWhen: Choosing one value from a fixed list of about 6 or more options (country, payment method, frequency)
KYC fields like employment status or income band
Locked choices during processing: State=disabled
dontUseWhen: Long lists where typing helps (banks, cities, sectors): use Combobox Field with Combobox Menu
Two to five options that fit on screen: use Radio Group
Free text: use Input
Picking dates: use Date Input
Picking a Saudi region with chips: use ProvinceSelector
1024:183.keyProps: State (default, active, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Helper text, Direction; not yet in the published library.
1024:183.a11y: Required Selects left empty on submit show State=error with «يرجى اختيار خيار» in the helper, not only a toast.

1041:57.name: Checkbox Indicator
1041:57.description: The square box atom of a checkbox with checked, indeterminate and disabled visuals.
useWhen: Inside Checkbox
Select-all cells in table headers or rows where the row is the label
dontUseWhen: A labelled choice: use Checkbox
Exclusive choices: use Radio Indicator inside Radio
1041:57.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), State (unchecked, hover, focus, checked, indeterminate, disabled-unchecked, disabled-checked); no Direction, it is symmetric.
1041:57.a11y: Standalone use needs an accessible name and a 24dp+ tap region; sm is 16dp.

1043:93.name: Checkbox
1043:93.description: A labelled checkbox for independent yes or no choices applied on submit, such as accepting terms or multi-select filters.
useWhen: Accepting terms, risk disclosure or Sharia terms before investing
Multi-select filters (Residential, Commercial, Industrial)
Select-all with partial selection: State=indeterminate
dontUseWhen: Only one option may be chosen: use Radio inside Radio Group
The setting applies instantly on tap: use Switch
Several related checkboxes under one label: use Checkbox Group
1043:93.keyProps: State (unchecked, hover, focus, checked, indeterminate, disabled-unchecked, disabled-checked), Size, Label text, Show Helper, Helper text, Direction.
1043:93.a11y: The whole label is the tap target; avoid sm on touch screens and never pre-check consent boxes.

3921:241732.name: Checkbox Group
3921:241732.description: A group label, a vertical stack of Checkbox items and a helper line for multi-select questions.
useWhen: Multi-select KYC questions such as investment goals or sources of income
Notification topics (new deals, payouts, account updates) chosen together and saved on submit
dontUseWhen: Exactly one answer: use Radio Group
Instant on/off settings: use Switch rows in an ActionList
Long option lists: use Multi-select field
3921:241732.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), Direction; override labels and states on the nested Checkbox items.
3921:241732.a11y: Expose the group label as the group name so each option is announced in context.

1086:177.name: Radio Group
1086:177.description: A group label with 2 to 6 stacked Radio items where exactly one is selected.
useWhen: Choosing one payment method or one payout destination
Investor type or contribution frequency questions in KYC
Showing a locked option the user can unlock later: disabled-unselected item
dontUseWhen: Several answers allowed: use Checkbox Group
More than about 6 options: use Select
A single on/off: use Switch
Rich selectable cards or rows on a full screen: use SelectionList
1086:177.keyProps: Group label text, Show Helper, Helper text, Size (lg, md, sm), Direction; ships 4 items, add or edit the nested Radio items; not yet in the published library.
1086:177.a11y: Arrow keys move selection within the group, and the group label names the radiogroup.

1081:57.name: Radio Indicator
1081:57.description: The circle atom of a radio button with a green dot when selected.
useWhen: Inside Radio
Custom selectable rows that need the standard radio mark
dontUseWhen: A labelled option: use Radio
Independent toggles: use Checkbox Indicator
1081:57.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), State (unselected, hover, focus, selected, disabled-unselected, disabled-selected); no Direction.
1081:57.a11y: sm is 16dp; extend the tap area to the whole row.

1083:69.name: Radio
1083:69.description: A single labelled radio option, always used inside a group of two or more mutually exclusive choices.
useWhen: Items inside Radio Group
One option of an exclusive choice that needs its own helper line
dontUseWhen: Standing alone for yes or no: use Checkbox or Switch
Multi-select: use Checkbox
1083:69.keyProps: State (unselected, hover, focus, selected, disabled-unselected, disabled-selected), Size, Label text, Show Helper, Helper text, Direction.
1083:69.a11y: Never use one Radio alone; the whole label row is the tap target.

1099:57.name: Switch Indicator
1099:57.description: The pill track and sliding thumb atom of a switch (thumb right means on in both directions).
useWhen: Inside Switch
Toggle slot of ListItem or ActionList rows where the row text is the label
dontUseWhen: A labelled toggle: use Switch
1099:57.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), State (off, on, hover-off, hover-on, focus-off, focus-on, disabled-off, disabled-on); no Direction.
1099:57.a11y: Expose as a switch with on/off state and a name from the row label.

1101:105.name: Switch
1101:105.description: A labelled on/off toggle that applies the setting immediately with no submit button.
useWhen: Notification channel preferences
Face ID or biometric login, 2FA on/off
Auto-invest or marketing opt-in settings
Settings forced by policy: State=disabled-on with a helper
dontUseWhen: The value is saved on submit (terms acceptance, form answers): use Checkbox
Picking one of several options: use Radio Group or SegmentedControl_2/_3
Several independent options in a form: use Checkbox Group
1101:105.keyProps: State (off, on, hover-off, hover-on, focus-off, focus-on, disabled-off, disabled-on), Size, Label text, Show Helper, Helper text, Direction.
1101:105.a11y: Do not flip the thumb in RTL, and confirm risky changes (turning off 2FA) because the toggle commits instantly.

1121:225.name: Slider Field
1121:225.description: A Slider wrapped with a label and helper for picking an approximate value within a range, with error messaging.
useWhen: Choosing an approximate investment amount within a deal range in a calculator
Risk tolerance or allocation percentage in onboarding
Showing a value locked by tier rules: State=disabled
dontUseWhen: The exact amount matters (investing, withdrawing): use Input Amount
Two-ended ranges (min and max): use two linked Sliders or Date Range Field for dates; there is no range slider
Small integer counts: use NumericStepper
1121:225.keyProps: State (default, hover, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Show Helper, Helper text, Show Tooltip, Direction; not yet in the published library.
1121:225.a11y: Support arrow keys and announce the current value with units (for example 5,000 ر.س); md and sm thumbs need a larger touch region.

1117:57.name: Slider
1117:57.description: The bare slider control (track, fill, thumb, optional value tooltip) for layouts that provide their own label.
useWhen: Inside Slider Field or a Form Field slot
Custom calculator layouts where the value is shown elsewhere
dontUseWhen: A primary form field that needs a label and error: use Slider Field
Precise amounts: use Input Amount
Showing progress (not input): use ProgressBar
1117:57.keyProps: State (default, hover, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Tooltip, Value text, Direction (fill starts at the right in RTL).
1117:57.a11y: Needs an external accessible name and value text when used alone.

1138:63.name: File Item
1138:63.description: Bare file metadata: filename, size and one action link (View file or Retry), with no card chrome.
useWhen: Listing an attached document inside an existing container (a form section or table row)
Showing a failed file inline with Retry: State=error
dontUseWhen: Upload in progress or the main post-upload display: use File Item with Progress
Starting an upload: use Upload Button
1138:63.keyProps: Filename, File size, Action text, State (ready, error, uploaded), Direction.
1138:63.a11y: Error must be stated in text, not only by the red filename color.

1141:63.name: Upload Button
1141:63.description: A compact attach-file trigger with paperclip, label and a supported-formats hint that opens the file picker.
useWhen: Uploading KYC documents, an IBAN certificate or an income proof
Any form field that accepts a file, with formats shown upfront
dontUseWhen: After a file is picked: replace it with File Item with Progress
Generic actions: use Button
1141:63.keyProps: Button label, Hint text, Show hint, Show Delete, State (default, hover, focus, disabled), Direction.
1141:63.a11y: Icons are 16dp; wrap them in 24dp+ tap regions and keep the format hint as readable text.

1147:63.name: File Item with Progress
1147:63.description: A file card showing upload progress, success, error with Retry, or the uploaded state with View file and remove actions.
useWhen: While a KYC document or IBAN certificate uploads: State=progress
Persistent confirmation of what was submitted: State=uploaded
Failed upload with inline Retry: State=error
dontUseWhen: Before a file is chosen: use Upload Button
Compact metadata inside another container: use File Item
Page-level loading: use ProgressBar or a Spinner
1147:63.keyProps: State (progress, complete, error, uploaded), Filename, File size, Direction; complete is transient, settle on uploaded.
1147:63.a11y: Announce progress and the final result, and give the trash icon a label like «حذف الملف».

1174:63.name: Form Field Helper
1174:63.description: Helper text with tone color and icon (neutral, error, success, info) shown under a form control.
useWhen: Validation errors under a field: Tone=error
Advisory notes such as «يستخدم للتحقق فقط»: Tone=info
Confirming a check that matters (valid IBAN format): Tone=success
dontUseWhen: Page or form-level messages: use Alert or Banner
Transient confirmations: use Toast
Long explanations: use Tooltip from Form Field Label
1174:63.keyProps: Helper text, Tone (neutral, error, success, info), Size (md, sm), Direction.
1174:63.a11y: Tone is shown by icon and color; the text itself must say what is wrong.

1169:63.name: Form Field Label
1169:63.description: The direction-aware form label atom with optional required asterisk and info tooltip icon; supersedes Input Label for new layouts.
useWhen: KYC and compliance fields that need a regulatory explanation: Tooltip=true
Required fields: Required=true
Labels above custom controls not covered by Form Field
dontUseWhen: Section or page titles: use Section
Labels already built into Input or Select: do not add a second one
1169:63.keyProps: Label text, Size (lg, md, sm), Required (false, true), Tooltip (false, true), Direction; not yet in the published library.
1169:63.a11y: Do not write «(مطلوب)» in the label; use the asterisk and mark the control required in code.

1177:453.name: Form Field
1177:453.description: The layout wrapper that stacks Form Field Label, a swappable control slot and Form Field Helper so any input shares the same label and validation chrome.
useWhen: Mixed forms where fields use different controls (Input Field, Select, Switch, Slider, Checkbox)
KYC and bank-details forms needing required marks, tooltips and inline errors
Success confirmation on a field: State=success
dontUseWhen: The control already includes its own label and helper (Input, Select, Slider Field, TextArea): do not wrap it again
Grouping several fields under a title: use Section
1177:453.keyProps: State (default, error, success, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Show Helper, Direction; swap the Input Field slot for other bare controls; not yet in the published library.
1177:453.a11y: Label, control and error must be programmatically linked; State does not cascade to the swapped control, so set both.

1217:63.name: Date Input
1217:63.description: A field with a calendar icon that shows a date and opens Date Wheel Picker on mobile or Date Calendar Picker on web.
useWhen: Date of birth or ID expiry in KYC
A single date filter in transaction history
Each side of a From / To range inside Date Range Field
dontUseWhen: Start and end dates together: use Date Range Field
Free text dates typed by hand: do not use Input
1217:63.keyProps: Value text, Size (lg, md, sm), State (default, filled, hover, focus, error, disabled), Direction.
1217:63.a11y: Announce it as a button that opens a picker and read the chosen date in full (15 سبتمبر 2024).

1219:87.name: Date Wheel Picker
1219:87.description: The mobile wheel picker opened as a sheet from Date Input, for dates, times or both, committed with an Apply button.
useWhen: Picking a date of birth on mobile: Mode=single-date
Time of day such as a reminder time: Mode=time
Exact timestamps: Mode=datetime
dontUseWhen: Web and desktop date picking: use Date Calendar Picker
Choosing an investment term from a few durations: use SegmentedControl_3 or Radio Group
1219:87.keyProps: Mode (single-date, date-range, time, datetime), Direction; Arabic uses full month names and «تطبيق».
1219:87.a11y: Keep the 40dp selection row and hide or disable dates outside min and max instead of rejecting after selection.

1228:321.name: Date Calendar Picker
1228:321.description: The web month-grid calendar popover opened from Date Input, for single, range or multi-date selection.
useWhen: Date filters on back-office or web dashboards: Mode=single or range
Picking non-contiguous days (rare): Mode=multi
dontUseWhen: Mobile date entry: use Date Wheel Picker
Time selection: use Date Wheel Picker with Mode=time
A From / To filter: use Date Range Field, not a two-month calendar
1228:321.a11y: Support arrow-key navigation and Enter, and keep 40dp day cells.

1230:801.name: Date Range Field
1230:801.description: Two Date Inputs side by side (من / إلى) for a start and end date, each opening its own picker. This is the Safqah range pattern on mobile and web.
useWhen: Transaction history or statement period filters
Deal duration or payout window filters
dontUseWhen: A single date: use Date Input
Preset periods such as 30 days or 3 months: use SegmentedControl_3 or Tag Group
1230:801.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), State (default, filled, focus, error, disabled), Direction.
1230:801.a11y: Label each input distinctly (من, إلى) and validate that the end is not before the start.

1241:63.name: Search Input
1241:63.description: A search field with a leading magnifier and a clear X when it has text. Used above lists to filter or as the top of Search Dropdown.
useWhen: Filtering a deals list, transactions or investors in place
The input at the top of Search Dropdown
dontUseWhen: Header or toolbar search with little space: use Compact Search Trigger
Picking one value from a long list: use Combobox Field
Non-search text: use Input
1241:63.keyProps: Value text, Size (lg, md, sm), State (default, filled, hover, focus, error, disabled), Direction; not yet in the published library.
1241:63.a11y: Give the field a search role and label, and label the clear button «مسح».

1244:63.name: Search Result Item
1244:63.description: One result row in Search Dropdown: title only, with subtitle, with icon, or a recent search.
useWhen: Deal results with meta such as «صكوك · إغلاق نوفمبر 2024»: Type=with-meta
Document results with a file icon: Type=with-icon
Recent searches before typing: Type=recent
dontUseWhen: Options of a picker: use Dropdown Item
Rows in a standalone list screen: use ListItem
1244:63.keyProps: Type (default, with-meta, with-icon, recent), State (default, hover, selected), Direction.
1244:63.a11y: Expose rows as options so keyboard highlight (State=selected) is announced.

1256:171.name: Search Dropdown
1256:171.description: The floating search panel: Search Input on top with results, empty, loading or recent states below. Used for global search and typeahead.
useWhen: Global app search across deals, documents and transactions
Typeahead suggestions while typing
No matches: State=empty with a recovery hint
dontUseWhen: Filtering the list already on screen: use Search Input alone, no dropdown
Choosing a form value from options: use Combobox Menu
Full-page no-results states: use EmptyState
1256:171.a11y: Announce result counts and loading, and debounce queries around 250ms.

1264:171.name: Compact Search Trigger
1264:171.description: An icon-only search trigger for headers that expands into a full search field (with a keyboard shortcut hint on desktop).
useWhen: Search entry in an AppBar or back-office header
Dense dashboards or table toolbars where a permanent field crowds the layout
dontUseWhen: Search is the main task of the screen: use Search Input
Quick command access across the app on web: use Command palette
1264:171.keyProps: State (collapsed, hover, expanded), Direction; show the ⌘K hint on desktop only.
1264:171.a11y: The collapsed icon needs a label like «بحث» and focus must move into the field when it expands.

1281:63.name: TextArea Field
1281:63.description: The bare bordered multi-line input box with auto-expand and a vertical resize handle, without label or helper.
useWhen: The field slot inside TextArea or a Form Field
Custom layouts that compose their own label
dontUseWhen: A labelled multi-line field with counter: use TextArea
Single-line text: use Input Field
Notes inside dense tables: use TextArea Underline
1281:63.keyProps: Value text, Size (lg, md, sm), State (default, filled, hover, focus, error, disabled), Direction.
1281:63.a11y: Needs an external label; cap growth with max lines so pasted text does not break the layout.

1285:311.name: TextArea
1285:311.description: A labelled multi-line text field with helper and optional character counter, for descriptions and justifications.
useWhen: Source of funds explanation in KYC
Support or complaint messages
Deal descriptions with a length limit: Show Counter on
dontUseWhen: Single-line answers: use Input
Inline notes in dense admin tables: use TextArea Underline
No real character limit: turn Show Counter off
1285:311.keyProps: State (default, filled, focus, error, disabled), Size, Show Label, Label text, Show Helper, Show Counter, Direction; not yet in the published library.
1285:311.a11y: Validate length on blur or submit, not per keystroke, and announce the counter when near the limit.

1287:311.name: TextArea Underline
1287:311.description: A minimal multi-line input with only a bottom underline, for notes that should recede inside dense layouts.
useWhen: Internal notes on transaction or investor rows in the back office
Inline annotations where a column header provides context
dontUseWhen: Primary user-facing forms: use TextArea
Needs a box border: use TextArea Field
1287:311.keyProps: Value text, Size, State (default, filled, hover, focus, error, disabled), Direction; add a label with Form Field Label if needed.
1287:311.a11y: Pair the red error underline with Form Field Helper text.

3887:1126.name: Combobox Field
3887:1126.description: A typable picker field (editable text, clear X, chevron) that filters a long option list in Combobox Menu.
useWhen: Choosing a bank when adding an IBAN
City or sector selection from long lists
dontUseWhen: Two to five options: use Radio Group or SegmentedControl_2/_3
Short fixed lists: use Select
Searching content rather than choosing a value: use Search Input
3887:1126.keyProps: Text, Size (lg, md, sm), State (Default, Focus, Filled), Direction.
3887:1126.a11y: Expose combobox semantics with expanded state and the active option.

3888:1186.name: Combobox Menu
3888:1186.description: The open filtered list of Dropdown Item options under a Combobox Field, with a no-results state.
useWhen: The open state of Combobox Field while typing
No matches: State=No results with «جرّب كلمة أخرى»
dontUseWhen: Non-typable pickers: use Dropdown Menu
Global content search: use Search Dropdown
3888:1186.keyProps: Size (lg, md, sm), State (Results, No results), Direction.
3888:1186.a11y: Announce the number of matches and never show an empty box.

3902:1186.name: NumericStepper
3902:1186.description: A compact minus / value / plus control for small integer quantities with min and max clamping. It is not the process Stepper.
useWhen: Number of units or shares in a deal (small integers)
Number of installments or similar small counts
Value at a bound: State=AtMin or AtMax disables that button
dontUseWhen: SAR amounts: use Input Amount or Amount Stepper
Showing steps of a multi-step flow: use Stepper
Large or free-form numbers: use Input Amount
3902:1186.keyProps: Value, Size (lg, md, sm), State (Default, AtMin, AtMax, Disabled), Direction.
3902:1186.a11y: Disable the boundary button (aria-disabled) instead of ignoring taps, and announce the new value.

1306:63.name: Tag
1306:63.description: Small static pill that labels a category or short metadata with one of six semantic tones (sector, investor classification, document type, risk level). It is display-only and never interactive.
useWhen: Sector or asset-class label on a CardDeal, such as عقاري
Investor classification or document type in a list row or Table / Cell
Risk level or short metadata next to a deal title
Up to one Style=filled primary tag plus subtle secondary tags on a card
dontUseWhen: A deal or issuance lifecycle status (Raising, Funded, Late, Defaulted): use IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
An attribute label such as Verified, KYC complete or Sharia-certified with an optional icon: use StatusPill
A filter or selection the user can remove: use Tag Removable
A deal tier or marketing ribbon (Premium, Basic, Closed): use dealTags
Anything tappable that navigates: use Button or Link
1306:63.a11y: Meaning must live in the Label text, never in tone color alone (WCAG 1.4.1); read as plain text, no role=button.

1311:63.name: Tag Removable
1311:63.description: Tag with a built-in close X for dismissible filter chips and applied selections, for example an applied sector filter above the deals list. Always subtle style so the X stays visible.
useWhen: Applied filters in a deals search or filter header (Sector: عقاري)
Chosen values in a multi-select field shown as chips
User-picked interests or segments that can be cleared one by one
dontUseWhen: A static label the user cannot remove: use Tag
A status or attribute label: use StatusPill
Selecting a Saudi region chip in a selector: use RegionChip inside ProvinceSelector
A toggle between options: use SegmentedControl_2 (or _3/_4/_5)
1311:63.a11y: The X is a button with an accessible name like "Remove عقاري filter"; make the whole tag the 24px minimum target at Size=sm.

1313:89.name: Tag Group
1313:89.description: Layout container that arranges two or more Tags inline, wrapped, or as the first three plus a +N overflow counter. Spacing between tags is fixed by the component.
useWhen: Two or more tags together on a deal card (sector + type + risk), Layout=inline
A variable number of applied filters, Layout=wrap
Dense rows or table cells with many categories, Layout=overflow showing +N
dontUseWhen: A single label: use Tag on its own
Lifecycle status next to categories: place one IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor) separately, do not group it as a Tag
Wrap layout inside a horizontally scrolling Table / Cell: use Layout=overflow
1313:89.a11y: Expose as a list of labels; the +N counter needs an accessible name like "4 more tags" and Western digits.

1322:63.name: Badge Dot
1322:63.description: Tiny colored dot with no text that signals presence or unread state, such as an online indicator or a new-activity mark on a tab.
useWhen: Unread indicator on a TabBar item or notification bell
Presence dot (this is the dot AvatarWithStatus reuses)
"Has updates" mark on a list row where the count does not matter
dontUseWhen: Showing how many items are unread: use Badge Count
Any status that needs words (Approved, Funded): use StatusPill or IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
Presence on a user avatar: use AvatarWithStatus, which already composes the dot
1322:63.a11y: Decorative to screen readers on its own; the parent must announce the state in text, for example "new notifications".

1324:63.name: Badge Count
1324:63.description: Small numeric counter pill (3, 12, 99+) anchored to an icon or tab to show how many items need attention. Direction flips its anchor corner.
useWhen: Unread notification count on the bell or a TabBar item
Number of pending KYC tasks or documents on a menu entry
Count of new deal updates on a tab
dontUseWhen: Presence or unread without a number: use Badge Dot
A text status label: use StatusPill
A KPI number such as total invested: use Stat
1324:63.a11y: Pair with an accessible label ("3 unread notifications"); cap at 99+ and keep Western digits.

1485:151.name: IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
1485:151.description: Locked-copy lifecycle badge that shows investors where a deal (issuance) sits: Reserved, Raising/Confirmed, Fully Funded, Active, Matured, Repayment Due, Late, Defaulted, Completed and so on. Color and Arabic/English copy come from the Issuance Status Copy spec and use raw per-phase palettes on purpose.
useWhen: Deal status on a CardDeal, portfolio card or investment history row seen by investors
Status in an Issuance Row or NewsCard / Poster Actions
Status label in push-notification previews or a deal header for investors
dontUseWhen: A developer-portal surface: use IssuanceStatusBadge (Developer)
Admin or Monitoring dashboards: use IssuanceStatusBadge (Internal)
Generic attributes outside the lifecycle (Verified, Premium, Expired): use StatusPill
Sector or category labels: use Tag
Deal tier or marketing ribbon (Premium, Basic, Closed tab): use dealTags
Showing Reimbursed or PendingDrawdown to investors: never; the resolver maps them to Completed and Fully Funded
1485:151.keyProps: Status=Reserved|Confirmed|Funded|Active|Matured|Late|Defaulted|Funding Failed|Fully Funded|Completed|Partially Repaid|Private Reservation|Repayment Due|Written Off|Cancelled; Direction=LTR|RTL
1485:151.a11y: Status is carried by the label text (Arabic in RTL), never color alone; do not detach or recolor instances.

1486:171.name: IssuanceStatusBadge (Developer)
1486:171.description: Lifecycle badge set for the developer portal, covering the 19 statuses developers see, including operational ones investors never see (ListingPreparation, PendingLaunch, PendingDrawdown "Transfer in progress", RepaymentMonitoring, Reimbursed "Investors paid").
useWhen: Issuance list and detail screens in the developer portal
Developer-facing notifications about funding, drawdown and repayment
Showing a developer that Reimbursed means Safqah paid investors and their debt is not cleared
dontUseWhen: Any investor-facing surface: use IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
Admin-only states (OnHold, Dispute, Rejected): use IssuanceStatusBadge (Internal)
Non-lifecycle attributes: use StatusPill
1486:171.a11y: Same as the investor set: label text carries the meaning; pick audience from the signed-in user, not from the data record.

1487:107.name: IssuanceStatusBadge (Internal)
1487:107.description: Admin-only lifecycle badge for six internal states (ReadyForListing, PendingApproval, Rejected, ReservationsAllocated, OnHold, Dispute), English only and never user-facing.
useWhen: Monitoring team dashboards and back-office issuance tables
Audit logs and ops tooling that track pre-listing review
Back-office Table / Cell status columns
dontUseWhen: Investor screens: use IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
Developer portal: use IssuanceStatusBadge (Developer)
Generic back-office states unrelated to issuance (user verified, ticket open): use StatusPill
1487:107.a11y: Label text is the semantic; ensure contrast on back-office table backgrounds.

1552:50025.name: illustrations
1552:50025.description: Small isometric Isocon glyph set for deal lifecycle phases (Scheduled, Raising, Preparing, Active, Matured, Repayment due, In recovery, Defaulted), each with Right or Left alignment for RTL/LTR. It supplies the leading glyph inside IssuanceStatusBadge pills.
useWhen: Leading glyph inside an IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor) or (Developer) variant
A small lifecycle-phase pictogram beside a status in a dense list
Matching the badge glyph when building a status legend
dontUseWhen: Large empty-state or onboarding artwork: use Illustrations (the full Isocon set on the EmptyState page)
Issuance list row status icons: use Issuance Status Icon
UI icons such as info, check or close: use the Syntropy icon set
1552:50025.a11y: Decorative; hide from screen readers because the badge label already states the status.

1372:2.name: Avatar
1372:2.description: Single user or organization picture with a fallback chain Photo, Initials, Icon, Placeholder. Circle means a person (investor, admin), Rounded means an entity (developer company, bank, Safqah).
useWhen: Investor or support agent in a comment, list row or account header (Shape=Circle)
Developer company logo on a deal or NewsCard (Shape=Rounded)
Profile header in settings at Size=xl
Placeholder while user data loads (Type=Placeholder)
dontUseWhen: Showing online/away presence: use AvatarWithStatus
Several committed investors: use AvatarStack
Loading a whole row or card layout: use SkeletonAvatar inside a Skeleton composition
Brand marks of partners: use SafqahLogo, MadaLogo or AbshirLogo
1372:2.a11y: Photo needs alt text with the person or company name; Initials avatars expose the full name, not the letters.

1374:14.name: AvatarWithStatus
1374:14.description: Avatar with a Badge Dot overlay showing online, away, busy or offline presence, at sm/md/lg only.
useWhen: Support chat agent who is online now
Deal-room or chat participants where presence is actionable
Assigning a back-office reviewer who must be available
dontUseWhen: Past comments or activity feeds where live presence is misleading: use Avatar
Groups of users: use AvatarStack
Very small (xs) or hero (xl) avatars: use Avatar and state presence in text
1374:14.a11y: Announce presence in text ("online") alongside the dot; color alone is not enough.

1382:53.name: AvatarStack
1382:53.description: Overlapping group of 2 to 4 avatars with a +N counter for overflow, used to show social proof such as how many investors committed to a deal.
useWhen: "12 investors committed" on a deal page, always with a count label beside it
Reviewers or approvers of a document in back-office
Collaborators on a shared goal
dontUseWhen: A single person: use Avatar
The precise number as the main message: use Stat or KeyValue and keep the stack decorative
A full list of people: use List or ActionList
1382:53.a11y: The stack is decorative; the adjacent label carries the number for screen readers; +N uses Western digits.

1624:162.name: Tooltip
1624:162.description: Light bordered bubble with an arrow that appears on hover, focus or long-press to explain an icon, term or number. Supplementary only and never interactive.
useWhen: Defining a financial term such as Sukuk or net return next to a label
Explaining how expected return or a fee is calculated (Size=md with title)
Naming an icon-only IconButton
Clarifying an info icon on a KeyValue row
dontUseWhen: Content with a link, button or form: use Popover
Information the investor must see to decide (fees, risk, minimum): show it inline or with Alert
Form validation errors: use the Form Field error state and Form Field Helper
Rich explanations on mobile: use BottomSheet
Hover readouts inside charts: use Chart / ChartTooltip
1624:162.keyProps: icon (instance swap); Placement=top|right|bottom|left; Size=sm|md; HasTitle=true|false; HasIcon=true|false; Direction=LTR|RTL
1624:162.a11y: role=tooltip linked by aria-describedby; show on keyboard focus and long-press; never hide critical info in it.

1654:178.name: StatusPill
1654:178.description: Read-only pill that labels an attribute or state outside the deal lifecycle (Verified, KYC complete, Pending review, Sharia-certified, Featured) with a semantic tone and optional leading icon. It also serves as the delta chip inside Stat.
useWhen: Investor profile attributes: KYC complete, Qualified investor, Verified
Document or request states: Draft, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Expired
Compliance markers on a deal: Sharia-certified, CMA-regulated
KPI delta inside Stat (↑ 12% success, ↓ 3% error)
dontUseWhen: Deal or issuance lifecycle statuses (Raising, Funded, Late, Defaulted): use IssuanceStatusBadge (Investor)
Plain categories like sector or document type: use Tag
Anything removable or toggleable: use Tag Removable
Deal tier ribbons (Premium, Basic): use dealTags
A field validation message: use Form Field Helper
1654:178.keyProps: icon (instance swap); Tone=neutral|info|success|warning|error|brand; Variant=subtle|solid; Size=sm|md; HasIcon=true|false; Direction=LTR|RTL
1654:178.a11y: Keep 1 to 3 words of text; the icon is decorative and the text conveys meaning; no hover or focus states.

1678:598.name: Stat
1678:598.description: One headline KPI with label, display-size value, optional icon, optional delta StatusPill and optional helper text, for example Total invested 1.2M with ↑ 12% vs last quarter.
useWhen: Portfolio summary numbers: total invested, expected return, distributions received
Hero metric on a deal page such as expected return 12.5% (Size=lg)
A grid of 2 to 4 dashboard KPIs, one Stat each
Back-office overview tiles (active deals, investors)
dontUseWhen: Lookup details in a list (issuance ID, maturity, profit rate): use KeyValue
A value over time: use Chart / Line or Chart / KPI strip
A categorical status: use StatusPill
Funding progress toward a target: use ProgressBar
The portfolio balance header with hide toggle: use PortfolioHeader
1678:598.keyProps: Size=sm|md|lg; Layout=vertical|horizontal; HasIcon=true|false; HasDelta=true|false; HasHelperText=true|false; Direction=LTR|RTL
1678:598.a11y: Read label then value then delta; announce delta direction in words ("up 12 percent"), not by color.

1739:122.name: KeyValue
1739:122.description: Body-size label and value pair for lookup facts in detail panels and receipts: issuance ID, profit rate, maturity, trustee, transfer reference. Optional trailing icon for info, copy, link or chevron.
useWhen: Deal terms panel: profit rate, maturity period, minimum investment
Transaction or payout receipt rows: amount, date, reference number with copy icon
Investor profile or KYC details review
One row with Emphasis=strong for the key financial figure
dontUseWhen: The single hero number on a screen: use Stat
Multi-column data: use Table / Cell
Editable fields: use Input or Form Field
Tappable navigation rows with leading icons: use ListItem
1739:122.keyProps: icon (instance swap); label (text); value (text); Layout=horizontal|stacked; Size=sm|md|lg; Emphasis=default|strong; HasIcon=true|false; Direction=LTR|RTL
1739:122.a11y: Expose label and value as one readable pair; trailing icon needs its own accessible name (Copy reference).

1767:2.name: Divider
1767:2.description: One-pixel line, horizontal or vertical, solid or dashed, in subtle/default/strong tone, that separates rows or sections when whitespace is not enough.
useWhen: Between KeyValue rows in a deal terms panel (Tone=subtle)
Between sections inside a card (Tone=default)
Vertical separator between toolbar groups or side-by-side figures
Dashed before an optional or collapsible details group
dontUseWhen: Separating whole containers: use a card boundary or spacing
First or last element inside a card: omit it, the card edge separates
Rows inside ListItem or ActionList: use their built-in divider option
1767:2.a11y: Decorative; hide from assistive tech (role=presentation) unless it marks a real section break.

1823:18.name: TimelineNode
1823:18.description: Timeline dot with optional connectors above and below, in completed, active, upcoming or skipped state, with a swappable inner glyph (check, Riyal, clock).
useWhen: The node inside each TimelineRow of a payout or deal lifecycle timeline
A compact horizontal step marker
Payment nodes by swapping the glyph to the Riyal icon
dontUseWhen: A complete sequence with titles and dates: use TimelineRow stacked, or DealTimeline for the deal page
Form step progress: use Stepper or StepIndicator
Failure states: skipped means bypassed, not failed
1823:18.keyProps: icon (instance swap); Orientation=vertical|horizontal; State=completed|active|upcoming|skipped; HasConnectorAbove=true|false; HasConnectorBelow=true|false
1823:18.a11y: State must also be stated in the row text (completed, current, upcoming); only one active node per timeline.

1836:306.name: TimelineRow
1836:306.description: One event in a timeline: a TimelineNode beside title, date, optional description and optional amount. Stack rows with zero spacing to build a payout schedule, KYC progress or audit trail.
useWhen: Distribution or repayment schedule rows: First distribution, date, 12,500 with Riyal icon
KYC verification steps with dates
Audit trail or deal history in back-office
Short horizontal step labels (Orientation=horizontal)
dontUseWhen: The full Safqah deal lifecycle module on a deal page: use DealTimeline
Wizard step progress without dates: use Stepper or Progress via ProgressSegment
A percentage toward a goal: use ProgressBar
1836:306.keyProps: title (text); date (text); description (text); amount (text); node (instance swap); Orientation=vertical|horizontal; HasAmount=true|false; HasDescription=true|false; HasDate=true|false; Direction=LTR|RTL
1836:306.a11y: Render the stacked rows as an ordered list; first row HasConnectorAbove=false, last row HasConnectorBelow=false.

1873:2.name: ProgressBar
1873:2.description: Linear bar that fills to a known percentage, with an optional label row (Label, Value). The core use is deal funding progress such as 78% funded, plus profile completion and uploads.
useWhen: Funded % on a CardDeal or deal page (Tone=brand)
Profile or KYC completion percentage
File upload progress, switching Tone to success or error by outcome
Goal amount progress toward a target
dontUseWhen: Unknown duration: use ProgressBar_Indeterminate or a Spinner
Discrete steps (3 of 5 documents): use ProgressSegment composition
Named onboarding milestones with a reward: use MilestoneProgress
Dated stages: use TimelineRow
